    if w%2==1 and all(row[w//2]==grid[0][w//2] for row in grid):

        A=[row[:s] for row in grid]; B=[row[s+1:] for row in grid]
        horizontal=False
    elif h%2==1 and all(grid[h//2][c]==grid[h//2][0] for c in range(w)):
        s=h//2
        A=[row[:] for row in grid[:s]]; B=[row[:] for row in grid[s+1:]]
        horizontal=True
    else: raise ValueError('no separator')
    shared=set(v for row in A for v in row)&set(v for row in B for v in row)

    bg=next(iter(shared))
    return [[3 if A[r][c]==B[r][c] else bg for c in range(len(A[0]))] for r in range(len(A))]
